programmes.d: (3/5) Dissension in the Dominator ranks, as Rago and Toba clash over command of the Quarks.
(4/5) Jamie and Cully become trapped in an underground shelter and the air is running out.
(5/5) The Doctor has figured out the Dominators plan, but is it too late to stop them?
The Doctor is forced to use the emergency unit, removing them from time space dimension!
Zoe, Jamie and the Doctor are transported to a puzzling world where they are confronted by riddles.
The Doctor and his companions are apparently being tested, but by whom and why?
The Doctor and Zoe have to fight the fabled Medusa and a 21st Century comic strip creation.
The Doctor attempts to save his companions but instead finds himself imprisoned.
The Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic.
The Krynoid is on the loose in the Arctic.
The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod.
Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid.
The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it.
The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
The TARDIS arrives in no man's land during World War I.
The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe make their escape in Lady Jennifer's ambulance.
The Doctor discovers that they are on a planet where soldiers fight never ending wars.
The Doctor and Zoe penetrate the Aliens' HQ.
In the American Civil War zone, Jamie and Lady Jennifer join forces.
The Doctor sends Zoe to the war zones to assemble a resistance force.
The Doctor, Jamie and Carstairs have escaped back to the 1917 war zone.
The Doctor is captured by the War Chief.
The rebels seize control of the Aliens' HQ.
The war games are over, and the Doctor is put on trial.
On a desolate planet, the Doctor and his companions encounter the all-female Draahvins and their leader Maaga, whose ship has crashed there.
Intent on capturing the spacecraft of the hideous Rills, Maaga holds Steven prisoner; a lost episode reimagined in animation.
The Doctor and Vicki learn the truth about the Drahvins from the ammonia-breathing Rills; a lost episode reimagined in animation.
As the planet faces destruction, Maaga launches a final attack on the Rill base; a lost episode reimagined in animation.
No one recognizes the Doctor.
An engineer notes strange events.
A captured meteorite is alive.
The Doctor battles the Nestene consciousness.
UNIT is summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing power losses.
Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature.
The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor.
The Doctor attempts to make peace between the humans and Silurians.
The Silurian's infect Major Baker with a virus and release him to spread the infection.

As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure.
The Silurians intend to destroy the Earth's protective Van Allen Belt, destroying mankind.
(1/7) All contact has been lost with the Mars Probe 7 space mission.
(2/7) Recovery 7 returns to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed.
(3/7) The Doctor deduces that the occupants of Recovery 7 were not human.
(4/7) Quinlan, the Doctor suspects, is part of the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed.
(5/7) The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space.
(6/7) The Earth's crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within.
(7/7) The Doctor must return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.
UNIT is at a project run by Professor Stahlman who intends to penetrate Earth's crust.
The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters.
Transported to a parallel world, the Doctor discovers that England is under military rule.
In the parallel world, the drilling project is about to penetrate the Earth's crust.
In the parallel world, Earth's crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces.
As the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world.
The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world.
